responsibility: Implements RTL loop unrolling, including complete unrolling of constant-trip loops, runtime unrolling of countable loops, and simpler heuristic unrolling when requested. It decides unroll strategies and factors, duplicates loop bodies, rewrites exits and iteration control, and applies supporting optimizations inside the copies such as induction-variable splitting and accumulator expansion to keep the unrolled form efficient and correct. This is the main RTL transformation file for unroll/peel-style loop body duplication, separate from the small public declarations in loop-unroll.h.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual RTL loop-unrolling implementation and heuristics, including choosing unroll forms and rewriting duplicated loop bodies with induction-variable splitting and accumulator expansion. The same-stem header gcc/loop-unroll.h only exposes the small external entry points used by other loop code.
